GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing just under a length, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, maintained 4th place but couldn't find anything extra in the run home # Had Every Chance

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, awkwardly placed on heels rounding turn, shifted Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME) # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Became awkwardly placed at heels round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Soon After bit keen Restrained Settled Down 6th Outside 5 Lengths and Outside winner, Ridden Along x 500m clear run home Outside Best Going - this # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1200m, restrained from heels when the pace of the race slackened.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down 9th Outside 9 Lengths Good Pace on, Ridden Along x 500m clear run home out Wide kept trying without threatening - # Even Effort

Slow Out 2 Lengths Settled Down well back Inside 10 Lengths within 8 Lengths Turning for home Ridden Along , got to middle of track but not clrst path until 100m from line, Kept Finding - # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and slow to begin. Over-raced approaching the 900m. Inconvenienced over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well & pushed on crossing to the lead just under a length Clear (1200m), had company Inside 900 kept very honest, Under Whip 200, headed final 100 faded (x-over nose band 1st time) # led/little peace

Jumped awkwardly & Went Forward to 2 Lengths joint Lead on fence, went clear at 800m, and led 2 Lengths turning, Headed 150m weakening a little to the line. [Stewards: Rider reported it raced greenly whilst leading. Post-race vet exam revealed a poor recovery and the thumps.] # weakened last bit
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rdr reported mount raced keenly whilst leading. A post-race vet exam revealed a poor recovery and the thumps.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1/2 Lengths Clear Under Pressure Turning for home kept on tough to 100m Couldn'T Go On - # led, gave all

Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down 2nd last 9 Lengths off leader/winner within 6 Lengths x 500m held-up Nowhere To Go Until Straightening Up then kept trying without threatening - not run to suit - # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: In the middle stages raced ungenerously and close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Restrained to slot in Settled Down 6th 3 Wide with a trail 4 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths asked to go at the 400m, Just Kept Going One Pace - # 3 Wide 1-paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Hampered near the 1000m when awkwardly placed on heels. Raced wide.
